Evidence & scope

Distinct primary paper work or creator-defined benchmark family. Actual full primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-document scopes have exact author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews for every approved assertion. Initial first-peer-submitted drafts and the six original revise decisions remain preserved. Paper methods, current release versions, component tasks, and altered evaluation protocols are distinguished; no clinical accuracy, full payload recount, experiment reproduction, complete upstream rights clearance, worker employer/pay or supplier contribution is inferred beyond the cited explicit source statements. This metadata admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench · documents: The pinned usage guide specifies Linux amd64 containers, task_cleanroom_v6 inference images, task_v6 evaluation images and on-demand retrieval of test archives from Hugging Face.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.available-evaluation-release

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The guide says nondeterministic or flawed branches and tests are ignored and recommends the harness's summary logic for final scores.
  • This records available release instructions, not completed local execution or verification of downloaded images and test archives.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench · documents: ProgramBench's paper and current pinned dataset card report different difficulty populations: the paper lists 28 easy, 143 medium and 29 hard tasks, while the card lists 27 easy, 120 medium, 18 hard and 35 unrated.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.difficulty-version-conflict.precision-v2

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The paper's difficulty score uses code size and detected runtime dependencies; 22 repositories without recognized manifests receive a zero detected-dependency count.
  • The author retains both published counts without inferring that the task payloads are identical or selecting a reconciled population.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench · documents: ProgramBench reconstruction tasks supply an executable and usage documentation while withholding original source and evaluation tests; the stated default blocks internet access and permits implementations in any language.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.inference-isolation

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The paper describes execute-only permissions, separate build/inference containers, history removal and removing binary hash matches before evaluation.
  • Loopback networking remains for 18 networking tasks, and selected binary or uncommon-format input assets are supplied using an extension heuristic.
  • The author did not independently establish that the stated controls prevent every shortcut or leakage path.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench · documents: ProgramBench defines resolved tasks as passing every associated test without a cheating flag; partial test pass rate records relative progress rather than a percentage of implemented functionality.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.metric-meaning-and-limits

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The paper acknowledges that finite behavioral tests leave untested behavior and do not measure execution speed, memory use or disk footprint.
  • The author did not treat passing tests as proof of complete behavioral equivalence or production suitability.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

ProgramBench · documents: ProgramBench v1 contains 200 reconstruction tasks sourced from open-source repositories, with a reported 248,853 behavioral test functions and a median of 770 per task.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.programbench.task-unit-and-tests

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The test corpus combines newly generated tests with tests harvested from original repositories; the paper reports a 79.5% versus 20.5% split.
  • The author did not recount downloadable tests or treat each source program as a separate benchmark family.
